scope: Owned AppKit window with the production native provider, macOS 26.7 VoiceOver read through its AppleScript last phrase
finding: When one refresh made the focused read-only field editable, its element was replaced. A bare window layout change then moved VoiceOver to the containing group, which ignored the focus change. On origin/main this depended on notification delivery order and was intermittent; posting layout before focus without naming the element failed every trial.
correction: A refresh that changes focus names the newly focused element in its layout change (NSAccessibilityUIElementsKey) and posts focus afterwards. Losing editability still retires the writable element.
